newsitem.title: POLAND: Mostostal-Z convertible bonds seen H2 '97.
newsitem.headline: Mostostal-Z convertible bonds seen H2 '97.

text.p: The Polish construction company Mostostal Zabrze SA wants to carry out a planned issue of convertible bonds of up to 25 million zlotys in the second half of next year, the company said in a statement.
Late in August Mostostal Zabrze's shareholders approved the 250,000 five-year, convertible bonds issue with a par value of 100 zlotys each.
Mostostal earlier said the price of the bonds would be set as a 10-session average price of Mostostal shares plus a premium before the issue date.
Mostostal, based in southern Poland, wants to offer the bonds to large investors in a public offering, paying an annual coupon of no more than 80 percent of the yield of the benchmark 52-week T-bill.
The firm has signed an agreement with the Polish Development Bank (PBR) to manage the issue and plans them to be listed on the Warsaw bourse's bond market.
